remarks: WELCOME HOME to YOUR move-in ready, 3-bedroom, 1.5-bathroom, 2-story, traditional single-family home featuring a full walk-in attic! Located on the northern edge of the University District in Buffalo, NY, this property offers YOU the financial benefits of low city taxes while enjoying the nearby Eggertsville and Amherst amenities—just one block away from the UB South Campus (University at Buffalo) and the prestigious Lebrun Circle. Enter via the covered front porch and be greeted by a large welcoming foyer leading to a spacious living room centered around a stunning natural wood mantel above a wood-burning fireplace, original Arts & Crafts style accent windows, and gleaming hardwood floors that flow seamlessly into YOUR morning room and formal dining room. Continue through to find an additional gathering room equipped with a cozy wood-burning stove and sliding glass doors that open to YOUR freshly stained back deck—perfect for outdoor dining, relaxing, and entertaining! YOU will also love the updated, fully-applianced kitchen featuring abundant cabinet storage and generous countertop space. Upstairs, discover an updated full bathroom w/ an open closet, alongside a built-in linen closet and three (3) generously sized bedrooms. The front bedroom boasts a large walk-in closet, while one of the rear bedrooms opens directly to a private upper deck overlooking the fully-fenced backyard. The full basement includes laundry hook-ups, a utility tub, solid mechanics, and a bonus half bath. Outside, enjoy a well-kept deck, private green space, shed and a long concrete driveway providing plenty of off-street parking. If YOU need storage or extra living space, the full, unfinished attic w/ full tear-off roof above offers so much potential! Most furnishings negotiable, excluding mattresses, accent tables, plants & decor. Conveniently located with shopping, restaurants, local parks, public transit, and even Metro Rail access nearby. For owner-occupants, this home qualifies for Key Bank's Home Credit of $5k off Closing Costs, Premium Mortgage's Home Ready 3% Down w/ reduced PMI, and possibly other lender programs.
